inputs.hint: The creator's compatible original APKM reference filename is com.sega.CrazyTaxiplayhaven_6.0-80_2arch_7dpi_24lang_1feat_017e8b1c582569ff9682193551b7e22c_apkmirror.com.apkm. VR4ALL checks package and version contents, so a renamed copy can work. An already patched Crazy Taxi VR APK also works. Either can be inside a ZIP, 7z, or RAR.

inputs.label: Installed Colin McRae Rally 2.0 game ZIP
inputs.note: ZIP the complete installed PC game folder; an ISO, uninstalled CD, demo or console release will not work

inputs.label: Google Play GTA SA export
inputs.hint: Drop the complete 2.11.311 ARM64 export archive, base.apk beside its splits, or its export folder.

inputs.label: PS2-style audio pack
inputs.hint: On the download page, choose Original plan mod pack (1.41 GB). Save it beside your game files, then drop the .7z here. No extraction is needed.

inputs.label: Android RDR APKs or complete export
inputs.hint: Use your 1.58.63226194 ARM64 Google Play or Netflix game. A small APK or phone APK export can omit the world, cutscene and audio files. Keep asset-packs beside base.apk when using a complete export.

inputs.label: Additional RDR game data (if export is incomplete)
inputs.hint: Only needed when your phone or existing export is missing game data. These are about 3.7 GB of world, cutscene and audio resources. Select matching 1.58.63226194 split_game0.apk–split_game3.apk in a folder/archive, or a complete asset-packs folder. Complete exports need no separate source. Either edition may store packs privately; buying another edition does not guarantee export. VR4ALL does not include or download this data.

inputs.label: F-Zero X US Rev 0 ROM
inputs.hint: Drop your clean 16 MiB .z64 ROM directly or inside a ZIP, 7z, or RAR. VR4ALL checks its exact SHA-1.

inputs.label: Official Virtua VR Port Quest R10 package
inputs.hint: Download “Standalone Quest — Install using Windows PC (R10)” from the creator’s itch.io page. Drop its complete ZIP, an archive containing that ZIP, or the extracted folder. VR4ALL runs its ROM extractor and sends all three required game files to your Quest.

inputs.note: Keep the v1.0.3 ZIP packed. It must contain carnevil1_9.u32, sound102.u95 and 486_carnevil.u96.

inputs.note: Matching CarnEvil v1.0.3 CHDv5 disc. The port checks its disk identity and ROM hashes in the headset setup screen.

inputs.note: July 17, 1998 US UEL: all eleven ROM payloads. Use the preparation tool to normalize an owned archive; renaming a 7z file is insufficient. No CHD or separate BIOS is needed.

inputs.label: Owned original Virtua Cop Revision B vcop.zip
inputs.note: Keep the original arcade set packed. A complete combined ZIP with the 26 game/board ROMs and both I/O/LCD firmware payloads is supported. This port uses its own Download/vcop-vr folder, preserving the existing Cop VR game files.

inputs.label: Optional separate model1io2.zip I/O and LCD firmware
inputs.note: Provide epr-17181.6 here unless it is already in vcop.zip. The LCD firmware can be in vcop.zip, model1io2.zip or the separate optional hd44780.zip.

inputs.label: Optional separate hd44780.zip LCD firmware
inputs.note: Supply hd44780_a00.bin here when it is absent from vcop.zip and model1io2.zip. Keep the firmware archive packed.

inputs.label: Owned original Virtua Cop 2 vcop2.zip
inputs.note: Original arcade Model 2A set with all 30 game, CPU-board and video-board ROMs. Keep it packed. A combined ZIP containing these and the billboard firmware is also supported.

inputs.label: Optional separate segabill.zip billboard firmware
inputs.note: Provide epr-18022.ic2 in segabill.zip unless it is already inside vcop2.zip. Setup requires all 31 actual ROM payloads across the supplied archives; optional means a separate ZIP is unnecessary for a complete combined set.

inputs.label: Owned Gran Turismo 3 A-Spec disc image
inputs.note: Use an ISO made from your own PlayStation 2 disc. Other formats are not supported by this port.

inputs.label: Owned Bloodlines Vampire folder
inputs.note: Choose the Vampire folder from an installed original Steam or GOG copy, or a ZIP/7z/RAR containing it. VR4ALL downloads the creator patch separately and combines them on the Quest.

inputs.label: Owned Gunblade NY arcade set
inputs.note: Complete original Model 2 gunblade set. The game checks every required ROM payload.

inputs.label: Optional separate Sega billboard firmware
inputs.note: Needed only when the required billboard ROM is absent from gunblade.zip.
